background: State Street Corporation is the holding company of one of the world's largest custodian banks, earning fees from safekeeping, fund administration and asset management under the State Street Global Advisors brand.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across two of the three, the weakest of them at A, both on a stable outlook, with no move since a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 2 Dec 2015. Capital reads two ways: CET1 of 10.8% is in the bottom quarter of US banks while leverage of 6.2% is in the top quarter. For a custodian it is the risk-based measure that binds, and it leaves the least headroom of the figures held; no liquidity ratios are shown. Neither ratio has moved materially over the past four periods (figures to 30 Jun 2026), earnings have been strong with profit up 56% in the second quarter, and nothing adverse has been flagged in the last 90 days.
